entities.summary: Mujahid Ahmed Bello known by his stage name Fancy Gadam, is a Ghanaian afropop, amapiano, dancehall and reggae musician. In 2017, he won Ghana Music Awards for Best New Artist and in 2020, he was named Best Afrobeat Entertainer at the International Reggae and World Music Awards.
